# vantage

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/vantage>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The agent or standpoint from which the observation is made — the reified-object-property counterpart of [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md). Semantically, [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md) ⊑ [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md): when an annotated statement is promoted to a reified [`Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md), its [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) becomes the [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md) of the relator. The agent in the vantage role — an observer, a sensor, a perceiver — IS a standpoint ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)): no frame is privileged, and every vantage is a co-equal facet from which the claim is held. Range is [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) (encompassing both [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) and [`gmeow:Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md)) because a vantage may be a bare agent (person, organization, software agent, sensor) or a [`gmeow:Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md) individual when the frame needs its own identity. Non-functional: joint observations (a reading co-authored by two agencies) are valid.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md) from [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Temperature Reading

- **Source:** [`slices/core/observations/examples/temperature-reading.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/observations/examples/temperature-reading.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-observations-examples-temperature-reading)#example-slices-core-observations-examples-temperature-reading

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: a measurement is a reified Observation ( P11). A
# gmeow:Measurement records WHAT was observed (gmeow:observedFeature), HOW
# (gmeow:observationMethod), and from WHERE (gmeow:vantage — the sensor). Its
# result is NOT a bare number on the observation: the scalar lives in an
# entity-valued gmeow:ScalarQuantity wrapper that bundles the value with its UNIT
# and uncertainty, so a temperature is never asserted free-floating (P11 — every
# value carries its frame). The unit is aligned to QUDT by reference (P5).
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/observations/> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

# --- The measurement: observed feature, method, vantage, and an entity result.
ex:reading a gmeow:Measurement ;
    gmeow:observedFeature   ex:room ;
    gmeow:observationMethod gmeow:methodInstrumentalReading ;
    gmeow:vantage           ex:sensor ;
    gmeow:observationResult ex:temp .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the agent or standpoint FROM WHICH a reified [`Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) is held — the relator-edge counterpart of the [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) annotation, used when an annotated statement is promoted to a first-class [`Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) and its standpoint needs to be a role player.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the method ([`gmeow:observationMethod`](gmeow-observationMethod.md) is HOW, vantage is WHO) and for the subject ([`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md)); avoid implying the vantage is privileged — every vantage is one co-equal standpoint ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)), so joint and competing vantages coexist.

### How to use

- Bind a [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) (person, organization, sensor, software agent) or a [`gmeow:Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md) individual when the frame needs its own identity; for typed claims assert the bridging subproperty ([`gmeow:facetVantage`](gmeow-facetVantage.md), [`gmeow:usageNamer`](gmeow-usageNamer.md), [`gmeow:membershipAuthority`](gmeow-membershipAuthority.md)) and read [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md) by inheritance. On the annotation side the same standpoint appears as [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md).

### Scope notes

- [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md) ⊑ [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md): the reified relator edge is semantically subsumed by the annotation-property axis. This is NOT asserted as [rdfs:subPropertyOf](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subPropertyOf) because [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) is an [owl:AnnotationProperty](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#AnnotationProperty) (keeping the OWL 2 DL downcast clean, [Principle 3](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-3)) while vantage is an [owl:ObjectProperty.](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#ObjectProperty.) The subsumption is documented here and realised in the projection layer, not axiomatised in the reasoned core.
